# Domjet

> Domjet is a lightweight headless browser for AI agents, compiled from Rust to WebAssembly and embedded in Node.js 22+. Node supplies JavaScript execution, networking, timers, and filesystem access. The WebAssembly core owns page state, DOM, CSS, layout, paint, cookies, screenshots, PDF, browser contexts, and Chrome DevTools Protocol state.

## Documentation

- [Overview](https://domjet.dev/docs/): Product overview and first example.
- [Get started](https://domjet.dev/docs/getting-started/): Installation and first browser workflow.
- [Architecture](https://domjet.dev/docs/architecture/): Division of responsibilities between Node and the WebAssembly core.

## Install

```bash
npm install domjet
```
